item.title: GlideMix 1.1.18
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.18 (Mac and Windows)

Fixed: songs no longer land on the timeline in pieces 🎚️

  • Drag or double-click a song in and it stays one clip, every time. (v1.1.17 sometimes cut a song where it thought the beats moved off the grid, and could leave the second piece minutes away.)
  • Want to fix a song whose beats really do jump part-way (a demo stitched from loops, a mashup)? Right-click it and choose Split at grid jumps. It cuts just before each jump and puts every part back on the bar. Undo puts it back together.

Phrase colours for Lexicon songs on any computer 🌈

  • The INTRO / UP / CHORUS ribbon under each song now also shows for Lexicon songs on a computer without rekordbox (for example Windows). GlideMix works the phrases out itself in the background, a few seconds after the song lands.

One look for every track 👀

  • New View > Track view: show every song as Waveform, Spectrogram, Multi-view, Half-wave or Single wave in one go. Songs you add later follow the same look.
  • The same choice is in Preferences > Waveforms > Track view.

Same menus on the song and on the track name

  • Right-click a song or right-click the track name: both now have Color (Color by key, Clip color, Track color, Intensity, Reset colors) and Track visualization.
  • Half-wave and Single wave are no longer greyed out while Preferences is open.

Tidier stems download

  • The stems engine download now just counts its steps (1/4 … 4/4) instead of listing technical package names.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.17
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.17 (Mac and Windows)

New: songs that jump off their beat grid stay on the beat 🥁

  • Some songs don't sit on one steady grid: demos stitched from loops, edits, mashups. Part-way through, the beats move a few hundredths of a second, and from there the metronome and your other songs flam against the kicks.
  • GlideMix now hears this when you add a song with SYNC on (drag it in or double-click it): it splits the song just before the jump and slides the later part back onto the bar. You see the cut on the timeline.
  • Normal songs made on a steady grid are left exactly as they were.

Fixed

  • Double-clicking a song into an empty project, then Undo and Redo, no longer brings the song back off the bar.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.16
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.16 (Mac and Windows)

New: loops and repeats the Logic / Ableton way 🔁

  • Draw a loop in the ruler: drag across the top half of the time ruler and that section loops right away. Drag the loop's edges to resize it, drag its middle to move it, press L to turn looping on or off.
  • Loop a selection: drag over part of a track to select it, right-click and choose Loop (or press Shift+L). Split is in the same menu.
  • Repeat with Cmd+D (Ctrl+D on Windows): the selected section is copied right after itself on the same track, and the selection moves onto the copy, so pressing again keeps repeating it. With SYNC on the selection snaps to whole bars first, so the repeats stay on the beat. A selected clip repeats right after itself too.
  • The new keys are in Help → Keyboard shortcuts.

Fixed

  • "Connection to project file is null" when pressing Play after starting a new project.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.15
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.15 (Mac and Windows)

New: the transition as a DJ mixer 🎛️

  • Mix a transition on a 2-channel mixer laid out like a Pioneer DJM: CH 1 is the song going out, CH 2 the song coming in.
  • Each channel: HI / MID / LOW with KILL, a COLOR filter knob (left low-pass, right high-pass) and a channel fader. Below them the crossfader with Smooth / Constant / Cut curves.
  • BEAT FX: pick Echo, Reverb, Roll, Brake, Tape stop, Riser or Sweep, set LEVEL/DEPTH and hit the big ON/OFF.
  • REC: switch it on, press play and ride the knobs and faders — your moves are written into the transition as automation. Stopped, a move sets one point at the playhead.
  • Turn it on in Preferences → Transitions → The transition pill opens: The DJ mixer, then click the cog on a BEATMATCH / CROSSFADE pill. The classic transition window is still there.
  • Controls shown dim (TRIM, meters, Dub Echo / Sweep / Noise, FX frequency, EQ curve, some effects) are coming in later updates.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.14
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.14 (Mac and Windows)

Smooth S-curves 〰️

  • Volume and FX automation now ease in and out like a DJ riding a fader, the same S-curves as the tempo line. Right-click a point → Line: straight or Line: S-curve.
  • Crossfades are drawn as one smooth line per song instead of a row of dots.
  • No more stray automation points left on screen after a transition is changed or switched off.

Transitions

  • Right-click the BEATMATCH / CROSSFADE pill to switch a transition off: its fades, EQ and effects are removed and the pill turns grey. Right-click again to bring it back.
  • Add effect in the transition panel: each effect gets its own row with an on/off button, an amount knob and a remove button, like a track's effect list. Effects now act inside the transition only, not over the rest of the song.
  • Fixed on Windows: choosing an effect in the transition panel did nothing.

Mixing

  • Master effects with look-ahead (limiters): the playhead, click and exports now line up with the music.
  • Track height slider resizes all tracks in one smooth step.
  • A quick double right-click on a song in the library no longer adds it to the mix.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.13
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.13 (Mac and Windows)

Energy you can read at a glance ⚡

  • The ENERGY view is drawn like a row of level meters: green when the mix is calm, yellow as it builds, red at the peak. Solid, vivid colours instead of the faded ones.
  • The tempo line is now the same bright yellow as volume automation.
  • The library's Energy column shows LED blocks (one per point) and the number, like Lexicon.

Library

  • Keys as coloured badges in the key wheel's colours (Preferences → Music library → Show keys as coloured badges).
  • Zoom sliders above the list for text size and row height, like rekordbox's Font Size and Line Space.
  • Lexicon keys in other notations (Open Key "8M", traditional "Am") now get their colours, badges and harmonic filters.

Analysis

  • Analysis uses: Performance / Normal / Power saving (Preferences → Music library), like rekordbox.
  • The status line shows a steady "Analysing 7 of 20" with a progress bar and time left; no more flicker between songs.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.12
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.12 (Mac and Windows)

Much faster analysis ⚡

  • Mac: the beat grid is worked out on the graphics chip (Core ML), with the full, most accurate beat model. On our test Mac, 288 songs took 4 min 42 s (rekordbox 7 on the same songs: about 20 minutes). A new song is ready in about a second.
  • Windows: each song's beat analysis now uses all free processor cores, so a single new song is several times faster.
  • Beat grids are a little closer to rekordbox's (tested on 200 songs).

Status line at the bottom of the window, like Ableton and Logic 💬

  • Shows what GlideMix is doing: scanning your folders, "Analysing 7 of 20 · Artist – Title · about 1 minute left" with a progress bar and Stop, loading the rekordbox XML, working out energy, installing the stems engine. Then a short message when it's done.
  • Hover over any button and the status line explains what it does.
  • When a new version is out: "GlideMix 1.x is out · Click to update".

Library

  • The Rating column shows five stars, empty ones outlined, like rekordbox. Click a star to rate; click it again to clear.

Also

  • Help → GlideMix Manual: the full manual on glidemix.com.
  • About: Mixxx is thanked in one line instead of 400 names.
  • "1 song" / "2 songs" instead of "song(s)".

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.11
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.11 (Mac and Windows)

Energy for every song on the timeline ⚡

  • Songs without an energy rating (for example songs imported from rekordbox, which doesn't rate energy) get one automatically a few seconds after you put them on the timeline. The rating shows in the library's Energy column too. Their beat grid and key stay as they are.
  • Songs from Lexicon now show how their energy rises and falls (intro, breakdowns, drops), instead of one flat block.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.10
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.10 (Mac and Windows)

Fix

  • Import from Rekordbox XML… now opens the file chooser in your Documents folder (or the folder of the XML you used last). On Windows it used to open in a system folder.

Also see v1.1.9: rekordbox XML opens like Lexicon, with a progress bar while it loads.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.9
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.9 (Mac and Windows)

rekordbox XML import, like Lexicon 🎛️

  • Import from Rekordbox XML… (File menu, or right-click Rekordbox XML in the sidebar) now opens your rekordbox library in place, just like Lexicon: the song count shows next to Rekordbox XML, and its playlists and folders open beneath it.
  • A big XML shows "Loading 42%" with a progress bar while it is read, instead of nothing.
  • Before you have picked a file, clicking Rekordbox XML asks you for it.
  • A file that isn't a rekordbox XML gets a clear message.
  • The old way, copying every rekordbox song into your Music Collection, is still there as Copy Rekordbox XML into Music Collection….

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.8
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.8 (Mac and Windows)

Find Duplicates 🔁

  • New Duplicates under Music Collection: songs that are in your collection more than once (same artist and title, same length), side by side with the best copy first (WAV/AIFF/FLAC before MP3, then the higher bitrate).
  • Select extra copies selects every copy except the best one, ready for Remove from Library or Delete from Disk.

Smart Playlist generator ⚙️

  • Right-click Smart Playlists → Generate Smart Playlists: one playlist per genre, per key or per energy level, from your collection, Lexicon, rekordbox or all of them, in one go.
  • Delete Generated Smart Playlists removes them all again.

Small comforts

  • The sidebar marks every playlist and smart playlist that contains the selected song.
  • Each list remembers its sort, scroll position and selected song while GlideMix runs.
  • The Energy column reads "Energy 7".

Fixes and more

  • A folder added in Preferences → Music library is scanned and analysed right away (before, its songs came in at the next start).
  • A newly analysed song's cue markers now show at once (they needed a restart).
  • Energy is closer to Lexicon's ratings for high-energy songs.
  • New glidemix.com website: Help → Help and FAQ and Help → GlideMix website.
  • The licence window shows the Beta price: €49 (normal price €89).

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.7
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.7 (Mac and Windows)

Energy ⚡

  • New Energy column right after BPM: every song rated Energy 1–10, like Mixed In Key and Lexicon. Sort by it, and use it in Smart Playlists ("Energy 7–9 and BPM 124–128").
  • Lexicon songs show Lexicon's own energy. Your Music Collection songs get theirs from GlideMix's analysis, tuned to agree with Lexicon's ratings (songs analysed before this version: press Analyze once).
  • ENERGY button next to TEMPO: the energy of the whole mix drawn behind the tempo line, blue (calm) to red (peak). See how your set builds, where it drops, and where a breakdown or a long fade lets it sag.

Watch folders 📂

  • The music folders in Preferences → Music library are now watched while GlideMix runs: copy or download a song into one and it appears in your Music Collection a few seconds later.
  • New songs are analysed automatically (BPM, key, beat grid, phrases, energy). Both can be switched off in Preferences.

Cue points

  • The waveforms in the library now show each song's cue points, like rekordbox: hot cues A, B, C… in their colours and memory cues along the bottom.
  • Export to rekordbox XML gives songs without cue points hot cues where their phrases start (Intro, Up, Chorus, Down, Outro), on the beat grid, plus memory cues, so they arrive on CDJs ready to play.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.6
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.6 (Mac and Windows)

Smart Playlists ⚙️

  • New Smart Playlists in the library sidebar: playlists that fill themselves from rules, like rekordbox's Intelligent Playlists and Lexicon's Smartlists.
  • Pick from your Music Collection, Lexicon, rekordbox XML or all of them. Match all or any rules, with "or…" alternatives.
  • Rules for genre, artist, title, comment, BPM, key, rating, color, year, length, date added, last played, play count, playlist and more.
  • DJ extras: Key "mixes with" (harmonic) and BPM "within ±%" (half and double tempo count too).
  • "Only the 50 newest", a live count while you edit, and Duplicate as Playlist.

Export to Folder

  • Right-click any playlist (your own, smart, Lexicon or rekordbox) → Export to Folder…: the songs copied in order, plus a track list (.txt) and an .m3u8 for players and USB sticks.

Export to rekordbox XML

  • Right-click Music Collection → Export to rekordbox XML…: tracks with tags, stars, colors and beat grids (cue points for Lexicon songs), your playlist folders and smart playlists, ready to import into rekordbox or Lexicon. Their own databases are never touched.

Also

  • Home → Learn has a link to the new r/GlideMix community on Reddit.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.5
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.5 (Mac and Windows)

Tracklist with every export

  • Every exported mix now gets its tracklist beside it: a `.txt` with timestamps and Artist - Title, ready to paste into Mixcloud or your show notes, plus a `.cue` sheet. Times match the file, tempo changes included.

A friendlier demo

  • The demo no longer goes silent. Instead, every 2 minutes a voice says "Glide Mix demo" over the music, so you hear every transition in full.
  • Demo exports are MP3 at 96 kbps, up to 20 minutes. The export window shows it.
  • A licence (€49, one-time) removes all of it.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.4
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.4 (Mac and Windows)

Learn, right on Home

  • Home has a new Learn page: getting started, what's new, every keyboard shortcut, the Discord community, support by email, and your licence. All one click away.

Simpler automation recording

  • The LATCH button is gone. ARM works as always: while the mix plays, turn any knob of any plugin and the move is written into its line; let go and the line plays on as it was.

Meters like a DJ mixer

  • New installs start with gradient meters (green, yellow, red). Change the style any time in the meter settings.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.3
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.3 (Mac and Windows)

How loud is your mix?

  • After every export GlideMix tells you the loudness (LUFS), the true peak and the peak, and what Spotify, YouTube and Apple Music will do with it (they play music at about -14 LUFS).

Never clips, not even as an MP3

  • The master limiter now watches the true peak, between the samples too, and looks 1.5 ms ahead so it glides down instead of jumping. Mixes stay under -1 dBTP, so an MP3 or AAC made from them doesn't distort. It works on everything: speakers, headphones (CUE), export and broadcast, after the ROOM and CUE faders.

Smoother tempo changes

  • When two songs at different tempos overlap, the tempo now glides in an S-curve: it leaves the old tempo gently and settles gently into the new one, like a hand on the pitch fader. Right-click a point on the tempo line: Glide: straight or Glide: S-curve.

Fade shapes

  • Preferences → Transitions: crossfades and fades get a Shape: equal power (as before), linear, S-curve, early or late.

Touch or Latch

  • New LATCH button next to ARM. Off (Touch): when you let go of a knob, the line goes back to what it was. On: your last value keeps being written until you stop playback.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.2
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.2 (Mac and Windows)

One licence, everything included

  • GlideMix – €49 unlocks everything, stems included. One-time payment, 3 computers, all 1.x updates: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_4uiOdwpksKcRSApaB9BWrDJ0Scu1AFet9FgtC4ZQyQJ
  • Help → Licence… shows the one Buy button; keys bought earlier keep working.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.1
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.1 (Mac and Windows)

Better sound on smaller PCs

  • On computers with 2 cores (4 threads), GlideMix used a cheap sample-rate converter to avoid crackles. It dulled the highs: hi-hats and cymbals came out softer and gritty, in playback and in exports. It now uses a proper high-quality converter (windowed sinc), clean far below hearing, and still light enough for small PCs.
  • Faster computers, and every Mac with more than 4 threads, were not affected.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.0
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.0 (Mac and Windows)

GlideMix is in Beta

  • Every download starts as the free demo: everything works, but every 2 minutes the sound goes quiet for a few seconds, exported mixes get a short noise in those gaps, and an export stops after 20 minutes. The window title says *GlideMix Demo*.
  • A licence removes the limits for good. One-time payment, 3 computers, all 1.x updates:
  • Help → Licence…: buy, enter your key (from *Access purchase* in the order email), or Deactivate this computer to move the licence to another one. Activation needs the internet once; after that GlideMix works offline.

Source code

  • The complete source code of this version is attached (`GlideMix-1.1.0-source.tar.xz`, GNU GPL). Building it yourself can be challenging; we don't provide help for it.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.9
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.9 Early Preview (Mac and Windows)

Edit Tags

  • Right-click a song, or several selected songs, → Edit Tags…: Title, Artist, Album, Album Artist, Genre, Year, Track #, Composer, Grouping, Comment.
  • With several songs, a field they don't share shows Mixed and stays as it is unless you type in it.
  • Saved into the music files too (you can switch this off), so rekordbox and Lexicon see the change after re-reading the tags (rekordbox: right-click → Reload Tag; Lexicon: sync from file tags). Their own databases are never changed by GlideMix.
  • Edits on Lexicon and rekordbox songs show in GlideMix right away.

Also

  • About → credits: a Works with section for rekordbox and Lexicon.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.8
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.8 Early Preview (Mac and Windows)

Library: ratings and colors

  • Stars and colors you set show up at once (before, only after switching views).
  • Rate and color Lexicon and rekordbox songs too. GlideMix keeps these in its own library; Lexicon's and rekordbox's databases stay untouched.
  • Select Color offers rekordbox's 8 track colors (Pink, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Aqua, Blue, Purple), each with its color circle. The old list was too long for the menu to open.

Also new

  • A development history on the GitHub page: every change since the first build.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.7
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.7 Early Preview (Mac and Windows)

Fix

  • GlideMix could crash when you pressed Perform or Stop (the red Perform playhead), most often on Windows. Fixed.

Also in this version (from v1.0.6, now on Windows too)

  • Exported mixes no longer clip: export goes through the same engine as playback, with its limiter, the tempo line and all plugin automation.
  • Automation lanes: in Automation mode, Show in own lane puts a plugin's line in a lane of its own under the track. Optional; working on the clip itself stays the default.
  • Dragging songs from the library quickly no longer leaves a song stuck to the mouse.
  • GlideMix's own folder (new projects, exports) is now Music → Glidemix instead of Documents.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.6
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.6 Early Preview (Mac; the Windows installer follows)

Exports sound like playback

  • Exported mixes no longer clip: export now goes through the same engine as playback, with its limiter, the tempo line and all plugin automation. A 20-minute test mix: 0 clipped samples, peak −1 dBFS (before: over 1% of samples clipped).

Automation lanes

  • New, optional: in Automation mode, Show in own lane puts a plugin's line in a lane of its own under the track, editable directly, with its name and a close button in the track header. Lanes are saved with the project. Working on the clip itself stays the default and takes no extra space.

Fixes

  • Dragging songs from the library quickly no longer leaves a song stuck to the mouse.
  • GlideMix's own folder (new projects, exports) is now Music → Glidemix instead of Documents, and rekordbox.xml is read only once you pick it. GlideMix itself no longer asks for your Documents folder. (Some plugins keep their presets in Documents; macOS may still ask once when GlideMix first checks them, as it does for other music apps.)

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.5
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.5 Early Preview

More songs on screen

  • New: Single wave. In a track's ⋯ menu → Track visualization → Single wave, a stereo track is drawn as one waveform and its lane takes about half the height, so more of the mix fits on screen. Choose it again to get both channels and the full height back. It's saved with the project. The beat grid editor is unchanged.

Mac: this is the first update you can install from inside GlideMix: Help → Check for update → Install Update, then Install and Relaunch.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.4
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.4 Early Preview

Updates

  • Mac: updates now install themselves. Help → Check for update shows what's new; Install Update downloads it, and Install and Relaunch puts it in place and reopens GlideMix. No more dragging a DMG or clicking Open Anyway. (This update itself still comes the old way, one last time.)
  • Mac updater apps (Updatest, Latest, MacUpdater) can now see GlideMix and its new versions.

Fixes

  • Mac: no more crash when adding the 4th song or later to a mix.

Performing and stems

  • The performance's Stop button sits right next to PERFORM.
  • Stem lanes are named by the stem first: Drums — <song>, Bass — <song>, Vocals — <song>, Other — <song>.

Behind the scenes

  • Windows: GlideMix writes down every audio dropout during a performance, with the timings, to find the cause of crackles in transitions.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.3
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.3 Early Preview

Keyboard shortcuts

  • New: Help → Keyboard shortcuts lists every shortcut, A to Z, with what it does and a search box.
  • Edit shortcuts… opens the shortcut editor (Preferences → Shortcuts): change any key, clear it, import or export a whole set. Picking a key that is already in use tells you which action has it before anything changes.

Building a mix with many songs

  • Add as many songs as you like: dragging a song under the last lane works every time, and the last lane always keeps room below it for the next one.
  • No more blink after a drop: the lanes no longer rebuild, so adding the 10th song is as quick as the 2nd.
  • The zoom stays where you set it, as in Ableton or Logic. The view only scrolls when the new song lands off screen. Cmd+F / Ctrl+F fits the whole mix.
  • Double-click a song in the library to add it at the end of the mix, linked to the last song.
  • Windows: the music library docks full width under the timeline, as on the Mac.

Automation

  • Plugin knobs draw and play as smooth ramps. Only switches and short choice lists (like an effect selector) step.

Look

  • Mac: no empty band above the toolbar on MacBooks with a notch; full screen no longer hides the top row.
  • Windows: the GlideMix icon on every window and plugin window, and in the installer.
  • The turntable artwork moved from the Home page to the start-up screen.
  • Folder pickers open in your Music folder.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.2
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.2 Early Preview

Faster analysis

  • Tracks you already analysed in rekordbox or Lexicon take their beat grid from there (and Lexicon's key): a few seconds per batch instead of seconds per track.
  • Other tracks use a faster beat detector by default, about 1.7× quicker. For the most exact grids, turn on Preferences → Music library → Accurate beat analysis.
  • The progress bar no longer sits at 95% while a track is being analysed.

Building a mix

  • Dragging songs from the library one after another works every time (every other song used to get lost on the Mac).
  • After a drop the view zooms and scrolls to the new song, together with the song before it and the one after it.
  • New lanes scroll into view instead of appearing below the visible area.

Updates

  • Windows: updates install by themselves and GlideMix reopens.
  • The update window names the version it found.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.1
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.1 Early Preview — the first build that updates itself.

New

  • GlideMix now checks for new versions when it starts and shows what changed. You can also check any time with Help → Check for updates…
  • Better phrase detection (Intro, Chorus, Down, Outro…), trained on 35,000 tracks. Re-analyse tracks to get the new phrases.
  • Windows: library preview works, for every format.
  • Windows: Preferences are also in File and in a new Settings menu.

Mixing

  • A track dropped near another track's OUT snaps its IN onto it, at any zoom.
  • Dragging a song moves only that song: no more songs jumping to the end of the mix, duplicated or moved by accident.
  • A song dropped on a taken lane gets a new lane right there, named after the song; empty lanes are removed.
  • New lanes have the same height as the others.
  • A song far from the mix tempo (more than 8%) plays at its own tempo and the tempo line glides to it, with points you can drag.

Sound and speed

  • Playback uses far less CPU: no more crackles on small PCs (an old bug re-read the audio 200 times a second).
  • A safety limiter stops loud overlaps from clipping.
  • Windows: all audio formats are read (AAC, ALAC, AIFF, FLAC, OGG, Opus, WAV, WMA), also with special characters in file names.

Fixes

  • The faint line across empty lanes is gone, so the grid looks even.
  • Zooming out stops at the length of the mix.
